errors.text: The proposed cryogenic thermal cycling does not reconstruct the target HPHT intervention at 6 GPa and 1473 K for 2 hours.
No thermal-cycling temperatures, cycle count, dwell times, or heating and cooling rates are specified, so the intervention is not reproducible.

The proposed lattice-distortion mechanism does not address formation of coherent interfaces, FCC-to-B2 dislocation transfer, hierarchical patterning, or suppression of interfacial stress concentrations.
No prior evidence is cited despite the explicit requirement for supporting evidence.
